title: Family name spelling and relatives; brother-in-law Bob Riley
summary: Phillips says his father played trumpet, confirms spelling, denies kinship with other Phillips musicians, and mentions his brother-in-law.

blocks.x: Can you tell us anything about your family, if they played music as your father? My dad used to be a trumpet player.
Yeah, he named the old Tile Phillips. Oh yes.
How is your last name spelled? Is there an S on the end, Phillips? Yes, yes. Phillips.
Were you in relation to the old bass player, you know Babe Phillips? No, I wasn't. Or any of the other, there's another trumpet player.

No, Joe Phillips, no, not the kid in the end. No, no, no, no. Bob Riley's his brother-in-law. My brother-in-law is Bob Riley. Poor yes. Louis Bob Riley, the one that stayed across the street here. Poor yes. Paul Bob Riley.
Yes, we know Paul, and we knew his father who died last year.
